hero.lede: A free, guided journey to help you get unstuck, quiet the noise, and take your next faithful step — one small, hope-filled day at a time.

empathy.statementAfter: of waiting, you're in the right place.
empathy.intro: You love God. You believe He's good. And still, somewhere along the way, the space between His promise and your right now has you asking, “Am I doing something wrong?” “Did I miss God?” “Why does it feel like everyone else is moving forward but me?”
empathy.close: Wherever you are, God is still moving, and over the next nine days, you can begin moving with Him.
lines: Maybe you feel stuck between where you are and where you believe God is leading you.
Maybe you've prayed the same prayer so long you've started to wonder if He heard it.
Maybe everyone else seems to be moving forward while you're still standing still.
Maybe you're not sure what the next step is.

items.title: Sign up free
items.body: Add your name and email below and we'll save your spot. It takes about ten seconds.

items.title: Open your daily email
items.body: Each morning for nine days, a short message lands in your inbox — one key, one Scripture, and one small step.

items.title: Take one step
items.body: Spend a few quiet minutes responding. No pressure, no catching up — just you and God, one day at a time.

items.title: A short daily teaching
items.body: A few honest, encouraging minutes from Jenessa to ground your day.

items.title: One key Scripture
items.body: A verse to carry with you and return to. [Placeholder — final verses to be added.]

items.title: A simple reflection prompt
items.body: One gentle question to help you listen and respond.

items.title: A small, doable step
items.body: Something you can actually put into practice today — no overwhelm.

items.title: Space to process
items.body: Room to journal, pray, and notice where God is already at work.

journey.heading: The 9 Day Challenge
journey.note: Note: the daily themes below are placeholders and will be updated with the final chapter themes from Moving with God.

items.title: Naming Where You Feel Stuck
items.body: Bring your honest starting place to God — no pretending required.

items.title: Remembering Who God Is
items.body: Return to the character of the One who is leading you.

items.title: Seeing Where He's Already Moving
items.body: Notice the quiet ways God is at work in your life right now.

items.title: Trusting His Timing
items.body: Make peace with the wait without letting go of hope.

items.title: Releasing What You're Carrying
items.body: Set down the striving, the fear, and the comparison.

items.title: Preparing in the In-Between
items.body: Use this season to quietly get ready for what's next.

items.title: Listening for His Voice
items.body: Create space to hear God's direction for your next step.

items.title: Taking the Next Faithful Step
items.body: Move forward with the little you can see in front of you.

items.title: Moving with God
items.body: Step into the promise with confident, hope-filled faith.

about.title: Hi, I'm Jenessa.
about.body1: I know what it's like to feel stuck — to love God deeply and still wonder when the things He placed in your heart will finally come. [Placeholder — a short piece of Jenessa's story / testimony to be added here.]
about.body2: I created this challenge because I don't believe getting unstuck happens through more information. It happens through small, faithful movement with God. Over these nine days, I'll walk it with you.

items.heading: What does it look like to move in step with God, not rushing ahead or falling behind?
items.quote: Jenessa Wait is a trusted guide to help you discern God's timing and move forward in confidence through every door He opens.
items.name: Rebekah Lyons
items.role: Bestselling Author, Speaker, and Co-Founder of Thinq Media

items.heading: Moving with God is not just a message Jenessa Wait teaches; it is a life she has faithfully lived.
items.quote: Walking through surrender, stewardship, service, and bold obedience to God's promises. With clarity and conviction, she offers nine practical and spiritual keys that help readers move from stagnation to possession of what God has spoken. This book will strengthen your faith, challenge unbelief, and anchor you in the house of God as you step courageously into His promises for your life.
items.name: Joaquin and Renée Evans

items.heading: Jenessa Wait is someone whose life speaks just as powerfully as her words.
items.quote: What has always stood out to me is her persistent teachability. She honors the voices God has placed in her life and leans in to discern what He is saying and where He is leading. In Moving with God, she brings that same grace to the reader, helping you see the Father's heart even in hidden or stretching seasons. With clarity and Spirit-led insight, she offers a practical pathway for partnering with God and stepping into His promises. This book will steady your heart, awaken fresh courage, and remind you that you are not forgotten. God is actively leading you forward right now.
items.name: Bethany Hicks
items.role: Co-Founder of Prophetic Company & Author of The God Connection

items.heading: Jenessa Wait's honest and vulnerable storytelling dismantles the addiction to hustle and calls us back to belief.
items.quote: From the very first page, Jenessa Wait beckons us into a deeper life of faith, trust, and vision. Moving with God serves as both an invitation and a guide into the life we ache for but often struggle to access. This book encourages readers to dream, take risks, and recognize God's presence. It challenges the status quo and invites us into a life marked by surrender and expectancy, emphasizing humility, trust, and laying everything down to truly find life.
items.name: Jessi Green
items.role: Author of The Invitation & Wildfires, Co-Lead Pastor of Salt Church

book.body: The challenge is completely free and can be completed on its own, but for the deepest experience, I recommend purchasing Moving with God before it begins and reading each chapter alongside the daily challenge. The book expands on every theme with personal stories, biblical teaching, and practical steps to help you get unstuck and move boldly toward God's promises.

items.a: Not at all — the challenge is completely free and stands on its own. That said, we absolutely recommend Moving with God as the perfect companion: read each chapter alongside the daily challenge for the deepest experience.

items.q: How long does each day take?
items.a: About five to ten minutes. Each day is short and doable — designed to fit into real life, not add pressure to it.
Yes. It's completely free, from Day 1 to Day 9.
The challenge starts October 6th, the day Moving with God releases. Sign up now and we'll make sure you're ready to begin on day one.

items.q: How will I receive each day's content?
items.a: On the day of launch, October 6th, you will receive your first day straight to your inbox. Each morning for nine days you'll get a short email with that day's teaching, Scripture, and step.

finalCta.title: Your next step is closer than it feels.
finalCta.body: You don't have to have it all figured out to begin. You just have to take the first day. Let's move with God — together.
finalCta.reassure: Free · Nine short days · Starts October 6th
